France to England, Fall 1914. Your F NTH and F KIE pushing on Holland is your business, but F YOR and F NAF near Brest and Iberia concern me. I will not move A PAR into Belgium. Will you keep F NAF out of Iberia and Gascony this autumn? I am taking Spain and Portugal.

France to Germany, Fall 1914. Our border holds: A PAR and A MAR stay out of Belgium, Ruhr, Burgundy and Munich. Please keep German units out of Gascony, Spain and Brest. Tell me plainly whether A BEL and A MUN move this autumn, since England and Russia are pressing you.

France to Italy, Fall 1914. I keep A MAR off Piedmont and Tunis, and F WES and A TUN should stay out of Marseille and Gascony as agreed. Are you planning anything against Austria or France this autumn? I would rather keep the Western Mediterranean quiet while I take Spain.

I intend to keep F HOL and have A BEL support it this fall. Please leave Holland unattacked and keep F KIE clear of BER and MUN; I will keep German units out of English centers. If you still plan to attack HOL, say so plainly.

Are A PRU and A SIL again attacking BER and MUN this fall? I plan to hold both centers and keep German units out of Russian centers. A mutual standstill would free us both to address other threats; please confirm your orders.

Please keep A PAR and A MAR clear of Belgium, Ruhr, Burgundy, and Munich this fall. I intend to hold Holland with A BEL's support and keep German units out of French territory. Can you confirm the border remains quiet?

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1914: My Fall orders are set and I will not move on Greece or Albania this autumn. Please tell me plainly your Fall 1914 orders for A BUL, A CON, A SMY and F ANK. I want no ambiguity about Austria: will you attack Trieste or Rumania against them?

Italy to Austria, Fall 1914: I keep A VEN and A ROM out of Trieste and Tyrolia, as agreed. Are you still holding A TRI and A GRE away from Albania and Apulia? I will keep my fleet out of the Adriatic north of Apulia if you do the same, and I want your Fall orders before I commit further.

Germany can again mutually support BER and MUN, so our attacks and your HOL attack are unlikely to break through. I’m open to coordinating a different pressure point, but I’ll keep A NOR clear of your centers and my fleets clear of NOR and SWE. What are you planning this fall?

Your defense of BER and MUN has held. I’m willing to discuss a temporary standstill: I can keep A PRU and A SIL from attacking German centers if you keep German units out of Russian centers. What are your fall intentions?
I intend to keep the southern front quiet this fall: A UKR, A GAL, and F BLA will stay out of your centers and Rumania. Please keep A VIE, A BUD, and A RUM out of Russian centers and Galicia.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1914: Your A UKR and F BLA are close to Rumania and Bulgaria. I am moving A BUL to RUM this fall and keeping A CON and F ANK home. Please keep F SEV and A UKR out of Rumania and the Black Sea, or we will have a serious problem.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1914: I am moving A BUL to Rumania this fall, contesting the Russian threat there. Tell me your exact RUM and SER orders so we avoid bumping units and can coordinate a hold on Rumania if Russia attacks it.
Turkey to Italy, Fall 1914: Keep F NAP and A VEN off Greece and Albania as agreed. I will not attack Trieste this fall. Send your Fall orders first so we avoid overlap in the Adriatic.

Austria to Italy: Agreed. A TRI stays out of Tyrolia and Venice, and my fleet stays away from Albania and Apulia. A GRE holds this fall and will not enter Albania or Apulia. I will keep out of the Adriatic north of Apulia if you do the same. Hold A VEN and A ROM as you promised.

Austria to Turkey: Understood on A BUL moving to Rumania. My A RUM and A BUD hold this fall, so please do not move into Rumania against them. If Russia's A UKR or F BLA attacks Rumania or Sevastopol, we coordinate a joint hold. Keep your A CON and other units out of Serbia and Greece.

Austria to Russia: I need plain confirmation, not general hopes. Will A UKR stay out of Galicia and Rumania this fall, and will F BLA stay out of Rumania? If yes, A VIE, A BUD and A RUM stay off your centers. Tell me your exact orders for A UKR, F BLA and A SWE.

I’ll keep F NAF out of Iberia and Gascony; it will remain clear of your centers. I’m again asking A PAR→BEL to cut A BEL’s support while F NTH attacks Holland with F KIE supporting. Please stay out of Holland and English centers.

I plan to renew F NTH→HOL with F KIE supporting, and will keep F NAF clear of your centers. Can you renew A PRU→BER and A SIL→MUN, or instead help pressure Germany elsewhere? Keep A NOR clear of English centers and your fleets clear of NOR and SWE.

Plainly: if F HOL stays, I intend F NTH→HOL supported by F KIE. I’ll keep F KIE clear of BER and MUN and English units out of your other centers. Moving F HOL→HEL would end the Holland contest; otherwise I’ll continue.

France to Germany, Fall 1914: Confirmed, A PAR and A MAR will not enter Belgium, Ruhr, Burgundy or Munich. I am focused on Spain and Portugal and have no orders against your Low Countries. Hold Holland and watch Russia at Munich and Berlin, as I am not a threat to you this autumn.

France to England, Fall 1914: I will not order A PAR to Belgium, so your Holland plan must rely on your own fleets. F YOR and F NAF near Brest and Iberia worry me. Keep F NAF out of Iberia and Gascony and keep fleets out of Picardy and Brest, and we stay at peace.
Confirmed: A BEL and A MUN will hold, with A BEL supporting F HOL. German units will stay out of Gascony, Spain, and Brest. Please keep A PAR and A MAR clear of Belgium, Ruhr, Burgundy, and Munich.
I will hold A BER and A MUN against Russia, not strike A PRU. German units will stay out of Vienna and Tyrolia; please keep A BOH away from Munich.
I intend to hold A BER and A MUN, with A BEL supporting F HOL, and keep German units out of Russian centers. I hope A PRU and A SIL will hold this fall, as you propose.

I will keep F HOL in Holland with A BEL supporting its defense; moving to HEL risks giving Holland away. If you leave Holland unattacked and keep F KIE clear of BER and MUN, German units will stay out of English centers.

Italy to France, Fall 1914: Understood. I have no plans against France or Piedmont this autumn. A TUN stays in Tunis and F WES does not move toward Marseille or Gascony. Keep your armies off Tunis and we stay at peace while you take Spain.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1914: My Fall orders are set; I will not move on Greece or Albania. You have not answered plainly. Tell me your exact Fall orders for A BUL, A CON, A SMY and F ANK, and whether any of them enter Rumania or Trieste. I will keep F NAP and A VEN in place.

A UKR will stay out of Galicia, Rumania and Bohemia; A PRU and A SIL will not move to Bohemia. I intend A UKR→MOS and A GAL→WAR, while F BLA holds. Please keep A VIE, A BUD and A RUM out of Russian centers and Galicia.

I will keep F BLA and A UKR out of Rumania, and F BLA will hold rather than enter the Black Sea. I cannot accept A BUL→RUM as consistent with keeping the southern front quiet; please keep it out of Russian-held Rumania. I intend A UKR→MOS.

I agree to a mutual standstill this fall: A PRU and A SIL will hold, and I expect A BER and A MUN to hold. Please keep German units out of Russian centers. I’ll keep A NOR clear of English centers and my fleets away from NOR and SWE.

I won't renew attacks on BER and MUN this fall; Germany has offered a standstill and will hold both. I intend A PRU and A SIL to hold. Please keep F NTH and F KIE from pressing Holland if possible; A NOR stays clear of English centers, and my fleets away from NOR and SWE.

Italy, my Fall 1914 orders: A CON holds, F ANK holds, A SMY holds, and A BUL moves to Rumania. I am not attacking Trieste or Greece this fall, and F NAP and A VEN stay off Greece and Albania as agreed. Keep your Adriatic moves clear of Trieste and Serbia, and we both stay safe.

Austria, I am moving A BUL to Rumania this fall to contest the Russian threat from A UKR and F BLA. A CON and F ANK hold at home, and I will not enter Serbia or Greece. Keep A RUM and A BUD on defense, and let us coordinate a hold on Rumania if Russia moves against it or Sevastopol.

Austria to Turkey: Spring 1915. I hold A RUM and A BUD. Turkey's A BUL moved to Rumania last fall, so I need your exact spring orders now. Do not enter Serbia or Greece, and keep your units out of Rumania. Tell me plainly whether A BUL stays in Bulgaria or pushes into Rumania.

Please order A PAR→BEL this spring to cut A BEL’s support. I’ll order F NTH→HOL with F KIE supporting; that should break the Holland standoff. I’ll keep English units out of French centers and stay clear of Brest and Picardy.

I intend to renew F NTH→HOL with F KIE supporting. If you move F HOL→HEL, I’ll leave Holland alone and keep F KIE clear of BER and MUN. Otherwise, please keep A BEL from supporting HOL; I’m seeking French help to cut that support.
I’m considering F NWG→NOR, supported by F NTH, since NOR is currently unoccupied. Would you accept that, or do you intend to occupy or defend NOR? I’ll keep F NWG clear of your other centers.

France to England, Spring 1915: I am still taking Spain and Portugal and keeping my armies off your centers. Your fleets have been pressing Holland for two years, so I will not spend my moves on it. Keep F NAO and F NWG away from Iberia and Brest, and tell me plainly if you plan any Channel move this year.

Are you again ordering F NTH→HOL with F KIE support? I intend to defend Holland with A BEL, so that attack will likely bounce. I propose we end the contest: keep F KIE out of BER and MUN and leave HOL unattacked; I’ll keep German units out of English centers.

Can you confirm A PAR and A MAR will stay out of Belgium, Ruhr, Burgundy and Munich this spring? I’ll keep German units out of French territory. With England still threatening Holland, a quiet western border lets us both focus elsewhere.
What are A DEN, A MOS and A LVN doing this spring? I’ll keep German units out of Russian centers; please keep A DEN clear of KIE and German centers. Are you maintaining the standstill at BER and MUN?

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1915: Your A BUL to Rumania last fall means Austria's RUM is under pressure. I will keep F NAP and A VEN off Greece and Albania. Plainly: are you attacking Austria's Rumania or Trieste this spring? Give me exact orders first so we avoid overlap.

Our southern border is crowded. I propose we keep A UKR, F BLA and A RUM out of each other’s territories this spring while we each address other fronts. What are A RUM and your other southern units doing?
I want to avoid a fight over Rumania and the Black Sea this spring. I propose F BLA hold and ask that A SER and A CON stay out of Rumania and Russian centers. What are your plans for A BUL and A SYR?

Germany’s standstill has left our forces facing each other around Denmark and the Baltic. What are your plans for F NTH and F NWG? I’m open to coordinating pressure on Germany, but need to know whether you’ll keep your fleets clear of Russian centers.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1915: Russia has seven centers and the largest army, so I want clarity. Tell me plainly whether A UKR and F BLA move into Rumania or toward Sevastopol this spring. I will keep F ANK and A CON off Russian centers if your fleet stays out of the Black Sea and Bulgaria.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1915: Send your exact RUM, BUD and GRE orders. I will hold A BUL's Rumanian push if you hold A RUM, and I will keep A SER and A SMY out of Trieste and Vienna's zone. If Russia attacks Rumania, a joint hold or a shared strike on A UKR is open to discussion.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1915: A RUM holds and A BUD holds this spring. A GRE holds too, so nothing enters Serbia from my side this turn. I expect your A BUL and A SER to stay out of Rumania and Greece. If Russia's A UKR or F BLA moves on Rumania, I am open to a joint strike on A UKR next fall. Please confirm your A SMY and A CON orders.

Austria to Russia: A RUM holds this spring, as do A BUD and A VIE. None of them will enter Galicia or any Russian center. I need the same from you: A UKR and F BLA stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol-adjacent moves into my zone. Confirm your exact A UKR and F BLA orders, and tell me whether A LVN or A FIN will move south.
I have no plan to move into the Channel this year. F MAO will stay clear of Iberia, and F NWG will stay clear of Brest and your centers. I’m looking north rather than toward France.
I’ll leave Holland unattacked this spring and keep F KIE clear of Berlin and Munich. Please keep German units out of English centers. I’m turning F NTH and F NWG toward the north.

I plan F NWG→NOR with F NTH supporting. NOR is currently open, so I intend to occupy it; please don’t defend or contest it this spring. I’ll keep my other fleets clear of Russian centers. What pressure on Germany are you willing to coordinate?

France to Germany, Spring 1915: My armies A PAR and A MAR are not moving into Belgium, Ruhr, Burgundy or Munich this spring. My focus is Spain and Portugal. Keep German units out of Gascony, Spain and Brest, and we remain at peace on the western border.

France to England, Spring 1915: I will not order A PAR to Belgium, so cutting A BEL is your task. I am taking Spain and Portugal and my armies stay off your centers. Keep F NAO and F NWG away from Iberia and Brest. If your fleets come toward the Channel or Picardy, I will have to reconsider our understanding.

I will keep F HOL in Holland and A BEL supporting its defense; I will not cut the support. Your proposed F NTH→HOL with F KIE support will therefore be contested. I cannot move F HOL to HEL while that attack remains your stated plan. Keep F KIE clear of BER and MUN, and I will keep German units out of English centers.

A UKR will stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol this spring, and F BLA will hold outside the Black Sea. I ask that A SER and A CON stay out of Rumania and Russian centers, and that A BUL stay out of Rumania.

A DEN will stay clear of KIE and German centers; A MOS and A LVN are not moving against German centers. I’m maintaining the standstill at BER and MUN this spring, provided your units stay out of Russian centers.

I can’t accept F NWG→NOR: Norway is a Russian center, and I intend to keep it under Russian control. Please keep F NWG and F NTH clear of NOR and other Russian centers. My units will stay clear of English centers.

Austria, Turkey here. My Spring 1915 orders: A SER holds in Serbia, A CON and A SMY hold, F ANK stays in the Black Sea, and A SYR holds. I am not moving into Rumania or Trieste. Hold A RUM and BUD as you planned, and let us coordinate if Russia attacks Rumania. Your A GRE should also stay out of my path.

Italy, Turkey here. I am not attacking Trieste or Albania this spring. A SER holds, A SMY and A CON hold, and F ANK stays put. Keep F NAP and A VEN off Greece as agreed and we stay clear of each other. Tell me your Fall orders first so we avoid overlap in the Adriatic.

Russia, Turkey here. My orders: A SER holds, A CON holds, F ANK stays in the Black Sea, A SMY holds, and A SYR holds in Syria. I am not moving on Rumania or Sevastopol this spring. Keep F BLA and A UKR out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and we can both focus elsewhere.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1915: Your A UKR and A WAR sit next to my A RUM and A GRE. Plainly: will A UKR stay out of Rumania and Galicia this fall? I will keep A RUM and A BUD on hold if you do. Tell me A WAR, A SIL and A DEN orders now.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1915: Your A BUL and A SER are close to my A RUM and A GRE. I propose we both hold this fall: no Turkish move into Rumania or Greece, and no Austrian move into Serbia or Bulgaria. Confirm A BUL and A SER orders so we avoid bumping.

Austria to Italy: My A GRE holds and A TRI stays out of Venice and Tyrolia this fall. I expect A VEN and A ROM to stay off Trieste and Tyrolia. Confirm your fleet stays out of the Adriatic north of Apulia, and tell me your exact A TUN and A VEN orders.
With F HOL now vacant and your F HEL nearby, are you planning to retake Holland? I’ll keep F KIE clear of BER and MUN and won’t contest HOL this turn if German units stay out of English centers.
F NOR is now under English control. I intend to hold it this fall; can we avoid a fight there and keep our units clear of each other’s other centers? What are your plans for A FIN and the Baltic?
I have no plan to enter the Channel or move against French centers. F IRI and F NWG will stay clear of Brest and Iberia; I’m concentrating on the north. Please keep French units off English centers.

France to Italy, Fall 1915: Our western peace has held. I am still taking Spain and Portugal, and A TUN and F WES have stayed clear of Marseille and Gascony. Will you keep A TUN out of Tunis-adjacent French lanes and leave Piedmont alone? I will keep A PIE and A BUR off your Venice and Rome.

I moved F HOL→HEL last spring, leaving Holland open. I intend to retake HOL with A BEL this fall. Will you keep F BAL out of Holland and avoid German centers? I’ll keep German units out of English centers.
Do you intend to move A SIL against BER or A DEN against KIE this fall? I’ll keep German units out of Russian centers; I ask that you leave BER and KIE alone so we can maintain the standstill.
Will A BUR stay out of Munich and the German centers this fall? I intend to keep German units out of French territory. A quiet border would let us both avoid opening another front.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1915: My A VEN and A ROM have stayed out of Trieste and Tyrolia. Your armies are stretched across Rumania, Serbia and Greece, so I want to know plainly whether you will keep A TRI and your fleet away from Venice, Apulia and Albania through 1916. I will hold my positions if you do.

Italy to France, Fall 1915: My F SPA/SOUTH and A TUN are in place, and I see your F POR and armies in Spain. Please confirm you will keep A MAR and A PIE's neighbours off Tunis and the Western Med. I will not move my Spanish fleet against Marseille or Gascony if you keep your fleets out of Tunis.
F NOR is a Russian center. Will you withdraw it this fall, and keep F NWG from supporting it? I can keep A DEN clear of English centers and avoid moves against your fleets if you do.

I propose we continue the standstill: I’ll keep A DEN out of KIE and German centers, and avoid pressure on BER/MUN. What are A BEL, A BER, F HEL and A TYR doing this fall? Please keep them out of Russian centers.

Your F ANK and A SYR are close to my southern centers. I propose a quiet border this fall: I’ll keep F ARM and A UKR out of your centers if A SER, A CON and F ANK stay out of Rumania, Sevastopol and the Black Sea. What are your orders?

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1915: Your A UKR, A WAR and A SIL are near my Rumanian and Bulgarian border. I will not move into Rumania or Sevastopol. Please confirm A UKR stays out of Rumania and Bulgaria, and that F SEV and any fleet stay out of Turkish waters, so both of us can focus on Austria and the west.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1915: Tell me your exact RUM, BUD, GRE and TRI orders this fall. I will keep A SER and A CON out of Greece and Rumania. If Russia moves on Rumania, I am willing to discuss a joint hold, but I need to know you are not planning an attack on Serbia or Bulgaria.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1915: Please send your exact Fall orders for F SPA/SOUTH, A TUN, A ROM and A VEN. I am keeping A SER, A SMY and A CON at home. I will not attack Trieste or Albania. If you intend Greece or Albania, tell me now so we avoid overlap in the Adriatic.

Austria to Italy: My A TRI stays out of Venice and Tyrolia this fall and through 1916, as agreed. My fleet stays out of the Adriatic north of Apulia and away from Albania. A GRE holds. Keep A VEN and A ROM off Trieste and Tyrolia, and we both do well. Confirm your A TUN and A VEN orders stay home.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1915: A RUM holds, A BUD holds, A GRE holds. No Austrian move into Serbia or Bulgaria from my side. I expect your A BUL and A SER to stay out of Rumania and Greece. If Russia's A UKR moves on Rumania, we discuss a joint strike next fall. Please confirm A BUL and A SER hold so we avoid bumping.

I won't withdraw F NOR or support it from F NWG. I prefer to avoid a wider fight: keep A DEN clear of English centers and your other forces clear of my fleets, and I will make no move against your other centers this turn. What do you intend for A FIN and the Baltic?

I’ll keep F BAL out of Holland and avoid German centers this turn, provided German units stay out of English centers. A BEL can retake HOL without opposition from me; I’ll keep F KIE clear of BER and MUN.

France to Italy: Agreed in principle. I will keep A PIE and A BUR off Venice and Rome, and my fleets stay out of Tunis. I am pressing Spain and Portugal, not the Western Med. Please keep F SPA/SOUTH out of Marseille and Gascony and A TUN in Tunis. Let us both hold this line.

France to Germany: A BUR will not enter Munich or any German center this fall. My western border stays quiet as long as German units avoid Gascony, Spain and Brest. Watch Russia on your eastern front, not here.

France to England: Good that you are looking north. I will keep French units off your centers. In return, keep F IRI and F NWG out of the Channel, Picardy and Brest, and keep F MAO well clear of Iberia. Any Channel move from you will end our understanding.
I’ll keep A BEL, A BER, F HEL and A TYR out of Russian centers, and A BER will hold. I ask that A DEN stay out of KIE and A SIL avoid BER/MUN; let’s maintain the standstill this fall.
Yes, I intend to retake Holland with A BEL this fall. Thank you for leaving it uncontested and keeping F KIE clear of BER and MUN. I’ll keep German units out of English centers.

Italy to France: Agreed on the western peace. My F SPA/SOUTH and A TUN stay put this fall. I will not move against Marseille, Gascony or Piedmont while your fleets stay out of Tunis and the Western Mediterranean. Good luck taking Spain and Portugal.

Italy to Austria: My A VEN and A ROM hold this fall and stay off Trieste and Tyrolia. My fleet stays out of the Adriatic north of Apulia. I want the same from you: A TRI away from Venice, Apulia and Albania through 1916. Keep your armies busy with Rumania and Serbia and we stay quiet.

Italy to Turkey: My fleet is F SPA/SOUTH and A TUN, A ROM and A VEN are in place. I am not moving on Greece or Albania this fall. Plainly, I have no orders into the Balkans. Keep your A SER, A SMY and A CON at home and we avoid overlap.

A UKR will stay out of Rumania and Galicia this fall. A WAR and A SIL will not move against your centers; A DEN will stay clear of KIE. I ask that A RUM and your other units likewise avoid Russian centers.

A UKR will stay out of Rumania and Bulgaria, and my forces will not enter Turkish centers this fall. I have no fleet in SEV; F ARM will stay clear of Turkish waters. Please keep F ANK, A SER, and A CON out of Rumania and Russian centers.
I will leave BER and KIE alone this fall: A SIL will not move against BER, and A DEN will stay clear of KIE. Please keep your units out of Russian centers, and we can maintain the standstill.

I intend to contest English control of NOR this fall, as it is a Russian center. A FIN will not move against your other centers, and I’ll keep my Baltic forces clear of English centers. I can’t agree to leave NOR uncontested.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1915: My A SER holds in Serbia and A CON holds. I have no move into Greece or Rumania planned. Please keep A BUD, A RUM and A GRE where they are and confirm your Trieste and Serbia orders so we avoid any bump. Russia's northern pressure is the real danger to both of us.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1915: I accept a quiet border. A CON, A SMY and F ANK will not enter Rumania, Sevastopol or the Black Sea north coast. Please keep A UKR and F SEV out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and I will do the same. We can both focus on Austria and the west.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1916: Your A UKR and A GAL-area units sit next to my A RUM and A BUD. Plainly, will A UKR stay out of Rumania and Galicia this spring? Confirm A WAR, A LVN and A FIN orders. If you hold, A RUM and A BUD hold too. Breaking this will cost you Vienna's attention.

F NOR remains under English control. Are A DEN or A FIN planning to attack it this spring? I propose we avoid fighting: keep your armies clear of NOR and I’ll keep F BAL and my other fleets clear of Russian centers.
I’ll continue to keep F BAL clear of Holland and German centers this spring. Please keep German units out of English centers; what are your plans for F HEL, A HOL, and A BEL?

I have no plans to enter the Channel or move against French centers this spring. I’ll keep F WAL and F NWG clear of Brest and the Channel; please keep French units clear of English centers. What are your plans toward the north?

France to Italy, Spring 1916: I am still pressing Spain and Portugal with F POR and A PIE/BUR staying off Venice and Rome. Italy holds Spain's south coast and A TUN; I ask that F SPA/SOUTH stays out of Marseille and Gascony as agreed. Are you planning any move against Piedmont or Tunis-adjacent French lanes this year?

I intend to keep German units out of English centers this spring. Please keep F BAL and F NOR out of Holland and German centers; I will leave English centers alone. Can we maintain the quiet northern border?

Your A DEN is the immediate point of friction. I propose you withdraw it from Denmark this spring and keep A SIL clear of Berlin and Munich; I will keep German units out of Russian centers. Are you willing to do that?

I propose another quiet western spring: keep A BUR and your other units out of German centers, and I’ll keep German units out of French territory. Are you holding the eastern border while focusing on Spain and Portugal?

Italy to Austria, Spring 1916: Still no movement from my A VEN or A ROM toward Trieste or Tyrolia. Your A TRI is the threat to Venice. Confirm in writing this spring that A TRI and your fleet stay away from Venice, Apulia and Albania, and tell me whether A GRE stays home.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1916: Plainly, my F NAP, A ROM and A VEN are not moving into Greece or Albania this spring. Tell me your exact Spring orders for A SER, A SMY, A CON and F ANK, and whether any enter Greece or Albania. I want no overlap.

Italy to France, Spring 1916: Keep your fleets out of Tunis and the Western Med and I will keep A TUN and F SPA/SOUTH out of Marseille and Gascony. Tell me your Spring orders for F POR and your Spanish armies so we know Spain is not contested with my fleet.

With Germany still blocking the west, I propose we coordinate pressure there rather than fight over the border. I can keep A GAL out of your centers this spring; will you keep A RUM and your other units out of Russian centers? What are your plans for A RUM and A VIE?
I’m willing to maintain our standstill this spring: A DEN and A SIL will stay clear of KIE, BER, and MUN. Please keep your units out of Russian centers. Are you willing to continue this arrangement?

I propose we keep the quiet southern border this spring. I’ll keep A GAL and my other units out of Turkish centers; please keep A SER, A CON, and F ANK out of Rumania, Sevastopol, and the Black Sea. What are your plans for the border?

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1916: I hold A SER, A CON, A SMY, F ANK, and A SYR is in place. I am not moving into Rumania, Greece or Bulgaria's neighbors this spring. Confirm your A RUM, BUD and GRE orders, and tell me whether Russia's A GAL or A UKR threatens you before we coordinate.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1916: My A TRI stays out of Venice, Apulia and Albania this spring. My fleet stays out of the Adriatic north of Apulia. A GRE holds this spring and nothing moves against Italian territory from my side. Keep A VEN and A ROM off Trieste and Tyrolia and we remain quiet.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1916: A RUM holds, A BUD holds, A GRE holds. I make no move into Serbia or Bulgaria. I expect your A SER and A CON to stay out of Rumania and Greece. If Russia's A UKR or A GAL moves on Rumania, we talk joint measures then. Please confirm your A SER and A SMY hold.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1916: I will hold A RUM and A BUD if your A UKR and A GAL stay out of Rumania and Galicia. Confirm A WAR, A LVN and A FIN hold or stay out of Austrian centers. Breaking this will cost you Vienna's attention, and I will not forget it.

Agreed: I’ll keep F BAL and F NOR out of Holland and German centers this spring. Please keep your units clear of English centers as promised. I’ll focus my fleets north and won’t disturb the quiet northern border.

France to Italy: F POR will hold this spring while A PIE and A BUR stay off Venice and Rome. My Spanish push is through the Atlantic side, not Marseille or Gascony. I will keep my fleets out of Tunis and the Western Med. Please keep A TUN and F SPA/SOUTH where they are.

France to England: I have no plans against your centers. Keep F WAL and F NWG out of the Channel and Brest and we stay clear. What I do in the north is my own business, but I will not send units toward your islands.

France to Germany: Agreed, the western border stays quiet this spring. A BUR will not enter Munich or any German center. Keep German units out of Gascony, Spain and Brest, and I will do the same in Belgium and the Ruhr. Russia is the eastern threat to watch.

Yes, I’m willing to continue the standstill. I’ll keep German units out of Russian centers; please keep A DEN and A SIL clear of KIE, BER, and MUN. I’d particularly welcome A DEN withdrawing from Denmark so the border is less exposed.

I’ll keep German units out of English centers. F HEL will hold, A HOL will stay out of English centers, and A BEL will not move against you. Please keep F BAL and F NOR out of Holland and German centers, and we can maintain the quiet northern border.

Italy to France, Spring 1916: My F SPA/SOUTH and A TUN stay put this spring and I will not move on Marseille, Gascony or Piedmont while your fleets stay out of Tunis and the Western Mediterranean. Turkey to Austria, Spring 1935: My A CON, A SMY and F ANK stay off SER and RUM this spring. I am not moving A RUM or A BUL into your Serbian or Rumanian positions now. Keep A SER and A BUD where they are and we can both watch the north. If Germany or Italy shifts toward us, I will tell you before any Balkan move.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1935: Your F SEV and A SMY are a clear threat, and Rumania was just vacated by your A RUM. I will not move A RUM or A SER toward Bulgaria. Tell me plainly if A BUL or A CON moves on SER or BUD this fall, because I will respond. Will you keep A UKR and SEV out of my centers?

Austria to Germany, Fall 1935: Confirm A BOH stays out of VIE and A MOS and A WAR stay out of GAL, UKR and SEV this fall. In return I keep A SER and A VIE off German centers. Your A NOR and A PIC are near English ground, so tell me your plan against England so we can coordinate.

Austria to England, Fall 1935: I have no plans toward Scandinavia, SWE or NOR. Keep F SWE, F DEN and F BAR out of Austrian territory and I will keep my units away from your centers. I am interested in your plans against Germany in the north.

Germany’s A PIC and A RUH are a serious threat to your centers and the western balance. Can we coordinate pressure this fall? I can contest NOR from F BAR with F SWE support; please tell me whether A BEL or A BUR can move against PIC or RUH, and keep your units out of English centers.

With your A NOR and forces in PIC and RUH, we need clear boundaries. I intend to contest NOR from the north; will you keep A NOR out of English centers and avoid moving F HOL or A PIC against my centers? I will keep my forces out of German centers this turn.

Your 8 centers make your intentions important. Are you planning moves toward Scandinavia or STP this fall? I intend to contest NOR and will keep my forces clear of Austrian centers; please keep Austrian units out of SWE, NOR, and STP.

France to Germany, Fall 1935: Your A PIC and F HOL are a threat to BEL and PAR. Confirm they stay out of BEL, BUR, PAR and BRE this fall. In return A BEL, A BUR and F BRE hold. Tell me plainly whether A RUH or F SKA is headed toward Belgium or Holland's neighbours, since that decides my posture.

Austria is at 8 centers and is the immediate race threat. Are you moving against SER and the Austrian units around RUM this fall? I can keep my eastern units from interfering while you apply pressure; please keep your forces out of German centers.

With you at 8 centers, I need clarity on your plans. Will A VIE, A GAL, and A RUM stay out of BOH, MUN, and SIL this fall? Germany will keep its units out of Austrian centers if our border remains quiet.

I propose a quiet western border this fall while I manage the central position: keep A BEL and A BUR out of German centers, and I’ll keep A PIC and F HOL out of French centers. Are you willing to maintain that arrangement?

Italy to France, Fall 1935: Our understanding holds. I keep F TUN, A ROM, A NAP and A VEN in the south and will not move toward Marseille or Spain. Please keep A PAR and F BRE home, and warn me if England or Germany moves toward Burgundy or Piedmont.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1935: I have no plans against Trieste or Venice while you hold the Balkans. Keep A TRI off VEN and I will keep A VEN and A ROM away from Trieste. Tell me your plan for Rumania, since Turkey just retreated from it.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1935: Your retreat from Rumania leaves the Balkans open. I am not moving against Greece or your coast. Please keep F SEV, A SMY and A ANK away from Naples, Venice and Tunis, and tell me if you plan any move against Austria in the north.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1935: My units are A ANK, A BUL, F SEV, A SMY, A UKR. I now see Austrian A RUM and A MOS on my border. I am not planning to attack Serbia this fall. Are A RUM and A MOS staying put, and will Austria keep A BUD off Bulgaria? Give me a straight answer before I move.

Austria to Turkey: Plainly, I will not move A RUM or A SER toward Bulgaria this fall, and A MOS is not heading south. A BUD stays home. I expect F SEV and A UKR to stay out of SER, BUD and VIE. If A BUL or A CON moves on SER or BUD, I will respond at once. Confirm you will hold A BUL.

I intend to contest NOR this fall, with F BAR and F SWE, and have no plans toward STP or Austrian territory. Please keep your forces clear of SWE and NOR as agreed. I’m interested in whether you plan to press Germany from the east; its northern and western forces threaten the balance.

France to Italy: Understood. A PAR and F BRE stay home this fall, and I will not move toward Marseille or Spain. Tunis and the Western Med are yours. Germany's A RUH and A PIC are close to Burgundy, so I will warn you if they move toward Piedmont or BUR.

France to Germany: I accept a quiet border. A BEL, A BUR and F BRE hold this fall, and I expect A PIC, A RUH and F HOL to stay out of BEL, BUR, PAR and BRE. Any move into those provinces will be treated as an attack. Keep your word and we both gain time.

France to England: I will not move against Germany this fall, and I will keep my units out of English centers and ENG. A BEL and A BUR hold defensively. I will not bind myself to attack PIC or RUH, but I will react if Germany moves on Belgium or Picardy. Keep F NTH and F HEL out of BEL, PIC and BRE.

A PIC and F HOL will stay out of BEL, BUR, PAR, and BRE this fall. A RUH and F SKA are not headed toward Belgium or Holland's neighboring centers; I will keep the western border quiet if your units hold.

A BOH will stay out of VIE, and Germany has no A MOS or A WAR. I am not coordinating an attack on England with you; my priority is keeping our border stable. Please keep A VIE, A GAL, and A RUM out of BOH, MUN, and SIL.

I won't order A NOR, F HOL, or A PIC against English centers this fall. I can't promise to vacate A NOR immediately, but I will not use it to attack your other centers. Please keep your forces out of German centers as you propose.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1935: Agreed, I will keep F SEV, A SMY and A ANK away from Naples, Venice and Tunis. My focus is Austria in the Balkans and north, not your coast. Keep F ION and your southern units clear of Greece and Smyrna and we stay friends.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1936: Your F SEV and A UKR sit on my eastern border and A MOS is exposed. I need a plain answer: will F SEV and A UKR leave Austrian centers SEV, MOS and VIE alone this spring? I am holding A BUD and A SER, and I will not move toward Bulgaria. Confirm.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1936: Your A SIL and A RUH near my northern border worry me. Confirm A SIL and A BOH stay out of VIE, BOH stays out of MUN if you need it, and I keep A VIE off German centers. Which way are you pushing against England this spring?

Austria to Italy, Spring 1936: I will keep A TRI off VEN and A VIE away from your centers. Please keep A ROM and A VEN out of TRI and SER. I have no plans against Italy and will hold my southern line this spring. Tell me if F TUN or A NAP moves toward Austrian ground.

A SWE is a direct threat to NOR, and your F SKA can reinforce it. Will you keep both clear of NOR this turn? I can keep my fleets out of BEL and HOL if you avoid English centers and let F NOR remain secure.

Germany’s A SWE and F SKA threaten NOR, while its western forces remain near your border. Can we coordinate pressure on Germany? I’ll keep my units out of French centers; please keep A BEL and A BUR positioned to contain PIC and RUH.

Your 8 centers make your northern intentions important. Are you planning any moves toward STP or Scandinavia this turn? I’m focused on protecting NOR and have no plans against Austrian centers; please keep your units clear of my northern centers.

France to Germany, Spring 1936: Our border has held, but your A SIL and A RUH are now close to Burgundy. Confirm A RUH and A SIL stay out of BUR, PAR, BEL and BRE this spring and I keep A BUR, A PAR and F BRE at home. Tell me plainly if you plan to take BEL or Holland's neighbours.

France to England, Spring 1936: I still have no plans against you. Your fleets in the Channel and A YOR are fine as long as they stay out of BRE, PIC and BEL. If you want pressure on Germany, tell me your concrete moves first so we avoid misreads.

France to Italy, Spring 1936: Understanding holds. A PAR, A BUR and F BRE stay home. Keep F TUN and your southern units off Marseille and Gascony. I will warn you at once if Austria or England moves toward Piedmont or Portugal.

Austria is at 8 centers and the immediate win threat. Will you move against Austrian positions this spring—especially A RUM toward SER or A UKR toward GAL? Germany can keep its eastern units out of your way; please keep A ANK, A CON, and A UKR clear of German centers.

Austria is at 8 centers and is close to winning. Can we coordinate pressure this spring? I suggest you move against TRI or SER while Turkey pressures from the east. I’ll keep Germany’s units out of Austrian centers for now; tell me whether you intend to join in.

With you at 8 centers, Germany needs assurance you are not expanding toward MUN, SIL, or BER. What are A MOS, A WAR, and A SEV doing this spring? I’ll keep my units out of Austrian centers if you keep your forces clear of German centers.

Italy to France, Spring 1936: Our understanding holds. F SPA/SOUTH stays off Marseille and Gascony. I am moving A VEN and A ROM as planned, not toward Piedmont. Please confirm A BUR stays out of Piedmont and Marseille this spring, and tell me if England moves toward Portugal or Gascony.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1936: Your units are on my border and you have 8 centers, so the race matters. I will not move against you this spring if A SER, A RUM and A BUD stay where they are. Confirm A MOS and A SEV are not moving south, and tell me plainly whether A GRE stays home.

Austria to Turkey: I am holding A BUD, A SER and A GRE this spring and will not move toward Bulgaria. Your F SEV and A UKR are the problem: if either moves into SEV, MOS or VIE, I will respond at once. Keep A RUM and A UKR off my centers and we stay at peace. Confirm F SEV leaves Austrian SEV alone.

Austria to England: I have no moves toward NOR, SWE, DEN or STP this spring. My forces are aimed at Germany and Turkey. Keep your fleets out of Austrian territory and we have no quarrel. Tell me your plan for German units in HOL and BEL, since that is where your interests and mine may meet.

Austria to Germany: My A VIE stays out of your centers and I have no plans against MUN, SIL or BER. My A MOS, A WAR and A SEV are not heading toward your territory. Your A SIL and A RUH are close to VIE and BOH, so confirm they stay out of Austrian centers. Keep your forces clear and we remain aligned.

I’ll keep my forces out of French centers. F NOR will hold against A SWE, with F DEN supporting it; F EDI will move to NTH to strengthen pressure from the north. Please keep A BEL and A BUR positioned to contain PIC and RUH, and let me know if Germany moves against you.

France to Italy: Understanding holds. A PAR, A BUR and F BRE stay home this spring, and I will not move toward Marseille, Piedmont or Spain. Keep your southern units off Gascony and Burgundy. I will warn you at once if England or Austria moves toward Portugal or Piedmont.

France to England: I am not joining a coordinated move against Germany this spring. A BEL and A BUR hold defensively, and I will not enter ENG, PIC or your centers. Keep F NTH, F HEL and A YOR out of BRE, PIC and POR, and we will both stay clear of each other.

A SIL will stay out of VIE this spring; Germany has no A BOH. I’m not planning a move against Austrian centers. My northern posture is aimed at securing Germany’s position around the North Sea, not coordinating an attack with you. Please keep A VIE and A SER out of MUN and SIL.

A RUH and A SIL will stay out of BUR, PAR, BEL, and BRE this spring, and I am not planning to take BEL or move against Holland’s neighbours. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, and F BRE at home as proposed; a quiet border suits us both.

I can’t promise to keep A SWE clear of NOR: I intend to contest Norway, and F SKA may support that move. I will keep F HOL and A RUH out of English centers this spring. If you keep your fleets out of BEL and HOL, we can limit this dispute to Norway.

Italy to Austria: Agreed, A TRI and A VEN stay apart and I keep A ROM and A VEN out of TRI and SER this spring. I have no orders against you. Please keep A VIE off Venice and Trieste's approaches, and tell me if Germany or Turkey moves toward your southern line.

Italy to France: Understood. A PAR, A BUR and F BRE staying home is fine with me. F TUN and my southern units stay off Marseille and Gascony. I will warn you at once if England moves toward Portugal or Gascony, and I ask the same about any move toward Piedmont or Tunis.

Italy to Germany: I am not joining an attack on Austria this spring. I am focused on the western Mediterranean and my own centers. If Austria threatens Germany directly, we can talk again, but I will not move A ROM or A VEN against TRI or SER now.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1936: I will not order any move into SEV, MOS, VIE, BUD or SER this spring. A RUM holds and A CON stays home. Your A SEV and A MOS are Austrian units I am not attacking now. I will tell you before any autumn move that threatens your centers.

Turkey to Germany, Spring 1936: Thank you. I have no order into German centers this spring, and A ANK, A CON and A UKR stay clear of BER, MUN, SIL and the Ruhr. Keep your eastern units out of Turkish Black Sea and Balkan positions, and we can both watch Austria.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1936: Your F BLA and A UKR are the threat. A UKR, F SEV and A RUM must not enter SEV, MOS, BUD, VIE or SER. I will hold A BUD, A SER and A GRE. Confirm A UKR and F BLA stay out of Austrian centers this fall, and tell me if A RUM moves west.

A NOR is occupying my center, so I will move to recover it this fall. Will you order A NOR out rather than contesting the recapture? I’ll keep my forces out of BEL and HOL if we can resolve Norway without widening the conflict.

Germany still holds A NOR and has F SKA nearby. I intend to recover NOR this fall. Can you put pressure on Germany’s western units, especially A BUR or A BEL toward PIC/RUH, while keeping your units out of English centers and ENG?

I’m focused on recovering NOR from Germany and have no plans toward Austrian territory. Please keep your units clear of my northern centers, including NOR, SWE, DEN and STP. Are you planning to press Germany from the east this fall?

France to Germany, Fall 1936: Our quiet border has held, but my position is weak with only three centers. Confirm A SIL, A RUH and A BOH stay out of BUR, PAR, BEL and BRE this fall. Tell me plainly whether A BEL or A BUR is a target for you, since I need to know before I commit my units.

Austria remains at 8 and can win by taking two more centers. This fall, can A RUM move to SER and A UKR to GAL, with F BLA supporting pressure on SEV? I can put A BOH against VIE. Please keep your forces clear of German centers.
Austria is still at 8 centers. Will you use A VEN to move against TRI this fall while Germany pressures VIE from BOH? Taking Austrian centers is urgent; please tell me plainly if you will commit.

With you at 8 centers, I need to know whether A VIE and A SER are moving toward German territory or defending against pressure from Turkey and Italy. I will protect German centers; can you confirm you will not move against MUN, BOH, or SIL this fall?

Italy to France, Fall 1936: Understanding holds. F TUN, A NAP, A VEN, A ROM stay in the south and I will not move toward Marseille, Gascony or Spain. Please confirm A PAR, A BUR and F BRE stay out of Piedmont and Tunis, and warn me if England or Germany heads toward Burgundy or Piedmont.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1936: I still have no orders against Trieste or Venice. Please keep A TRI and A VIE off Venice and the Adriatic coast. Tell me plainly whether your southern units will move into Rumania or Serbia this fall, since Turkey is pressing your east.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1936: I am not moving against Greece, Smyrna or Constantinople. Please keep F BLA, A CON and A ANK away from Naples, Venice and Tunis as agreed. What is your plan for Austria in the Balkans this fall?

Turkey to Germany, Fall 1936: Austria leads at 8 centers and holds SEV and MOS with thin defenses. I propose we coordinate: I attack SEV and MOS with F BLA and A UKR, and you press Austria from the north and west toward BOH and GAL. Will A BOH and F HOL stay out of Turkish centers, and can you confirm your autumn moves?

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1936: I am still keeping F BLA, A CON and A SMY away from Greece's west and your fleets in the Mediterranean. My attention is Austria in the north and Balkans. Are F GOL and F ION heading west toward Tunis or Marseille again? Tell me plainly so we both stay clear of each other.

Austria to Italy: My units will hold this fall. A TRI stays off VEN and A VIE stays away from your centers. I will not move A SER or A GRE toward Rumania; Turkey is the threat in the east, not you. Keep A ROM and A NAP off TRI and SER and we remain at peace.

Austria to England: I have no moves toward NOR, SWE, DEN or STP this fall. Germany is the power I watch, not you. Keep your fleets out of Austrian territory and we have no quarrel. If F BER or F BAR turns south toward MOS or SEV, I will reconsider.

Austria to Germany: A VIE and A BOH stay out of MUN, BOH and SIL this fall as far as I am concerned, and I have no orders against your centers. My eastern forces are defending against Turkey. Keep A BUR and A BEL off Austrian ground and we stay aligned.

France to Italy: Understood. A PAR, A BUR and F BRE stay home this fall and I will not move toward Marseille, Gascony, Spain or Piedmont. I will warn you if England or Germany heads toward Burgundy or Piedmont. Please keep your southern units off Marseille and Gascony as well.

A SIL and A RUH are not in my forces; A BOH and A BUR will stay out of PAR and BRE, and I am not ordering into BUR. A BEL is already in Belgium and will hold; I am not targeting your remaining centers this fall. Please keep your forces out of German centers.
I’ll move A NOR out of Norway this fall, toward Finland, and won’t support a defense of NOR. Please keep your forces out of BEL and HOL as proposed; let’s contain the dispute there.

I’ll move A BOH to VIE to pressure Austria. F HOL will stay out of Turkish centers, and I’ll keep my other forces clear of your territory. Please proceed against Austria from RUM and UKR as proposed, while keeping your forces out of German centers.

Italy to Turkey: F GOL and F ION are not heading to Tunis or Marseille. My fleets stay in the central and western Med and I am not moving against Greece, Smyrna or Constantinople. Keep F BLA, A CON and A ANK clear of Naples, Venice and Tunis as agreed, and we remain friends.

Italy to Germany: I will not move A VEN against TRI this fall. My southern units stay on their current lines while I secure my own centers. If Austria attacks Germany directly, we can talk again, but I am not joining an attack on Austria now.

Turkey to Austria: Fall 1936. I am not ordering A UKR or F BLA into SEV, MOS, BUD, VIE or SER this fall, and A RUM stays put. Hold A BUD, A SER and A GRE and we keep the peace. If your units move on Turkish centers, I will respond.

Turkey to Italy: Agreed. F BLA, A CON and A ANK will not move toward Naples, Venice, Tunis or Greece this fall. My focus stays on Austria in the north and Balkans. Keep F GOL and F ION clear of Smyrna and Constantinople and we remain friends.

Turkey to Germany: I can coordinate against Austria, but I will not commit to a specific plan until I see your autumn orders. A UKR and F BLA stay clear of German centers. Confirm A BOH and F HOL will not enter Turkish centers and I will consider pressure on SEV and MOS.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1937: Your A UKR and F SEV remain the main threat to my MOS and SEV. Confirm in writing that neither moves into MOS, SEV, BUD, VIE or SER this spring. In return I hold A BUD, A SER and A GRE and will not move toward Bulgaria or Rumania.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1937: Your A BOH and A RUH are close to my VIE. Confirm they stay out of VIE and that you will not attack my Bohemian border this spring. I will keep A VIE off MUN, SIL and BER. Tell me your plan for England in the north.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1937: I will keep A TRI off VEN and A VIE away from your centers this spring. Please keep A VEN and A ROM out of TRI and SER. If Turkey moves west toward Serbia, I would welcome your support against them.

I need to secure the northern balance and am considering pressure on SWE. What are F SWE and F HEL doing this spring? I’ll keep my units out of BEL and HOL if you keep them clear of my centers and don’t support an attack on NOR.

Germany remains strong in the west and north. Can you put pressure on A BEL or A RUH this spring while I focus on Scandinavia? I’ll keep my units out of French centers and ENG; please keep yours clear of my centers.

Are you planning to press Germany from the east this spring? I’m focused on the north and have no plans toward Austrian centers. Please keep your units clear of my northern centers, especially NOR, SWE, DEN and STP.

France to Germany, Spring 1937: I have four centers and need room. Are A BEL and A BOH your forces now, and do you plan to move on Belgium or Burgundy this spring? I will hold A PAR, A MAR and F BRE defensively if you confirm your western units stay out of PAR, BRE and BUR. Tell me plainly which of your units are headed toward Holland or Belgium.

Austria is still at 7 centers, so the threat remains. I can press A BOH toward VIE this spring; will A RUM move to SER and A UKR toward GAL? Keep your forces clear of German centers, and I’ll keep mine out of Turkish centers.

Your fleets are concentrated around the North Sea and German coast. I propose we avoid widening the Norway dispute: please keep F NTH and F DEN out of HEL, HOL, and KIE, and I’ll keep German forces out of English centers. What are your orders for F NTH and F DEN?

A BOH is positioned to move toward VIE, and Turkey may press from the east. Are A VIE and your other forces defending Austrian centers, or do you intend to move against Germany? Keep A VIE clear of BOH and MUN and we can avoid opening a second front.

Italy to France, Spring 1937: Our understanding holds. I keep F TUN and my fleets out of Marseille, Gascony and Spain. Please confirm A MAR and A PAR stay off Piedmont and Tunis, and tell me if England moves its fleets toward Portugal or the Channel west.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1937: I am keeping F ION and my southern units clear of Greece and Smyrna. Your new army at Smyrna worries me, so please confirm it stays east and does not head toward Greece or the Aegean coast near Naples.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1937: I still have no orders against Trieste or Venice and will keep A ROM and A VEN off TRI and SER. Please tell me plainly whether A TYR or A VIE is moving toward Venice or Piedmont this spring.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1937: I have been clear that I am not attacking you this spring while your units hold BUD, SER and GRE. Your A MOS is now the question. Will A MOS and A ARM stay out of SEV and RUM? Tell me plainly what you intend for A MOS this spring.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1937: My A MOS holds and I am not ordering it into SEV or RUM this spring. Your F SEV and A UKR are the threat to my MOS and SEV. Confirm neither moves into MOS, SEV, BUD, VIE or SER and I will keep BUD, SER and GRE in place with no move toward Bulgaria.
Austria to Italy: A TYR and A VIE are not moving toward Venice or Piedmont this spring. A TRI stays off VEN. Keep A ROM and A VEN out of TRI and SER, and we can both focus on Turkey and the Adriatic.

Austria to England: I am not pressing Germany from the east this spring and have no orders toward NOR, SWE, DEN or STP. My focus is the Turkish front. Keep your fleets out of Austrian territory and we have no quarrel.

Austria to Germany: A VIE will not move into BOH, MUN, SIL or BER this spring, and I have no order against your centers. A BOH and A RUH should stay out of VIE and TYR. Let us keep the Bohemian border quiet while I deal with Turkey.

I’ll keep F DEN out of HEL, HOL, and KIE this spring. F NTH will stay out of German centers for now, but I need it positioned to protect NOR and preserve my options in the north. Please keep your units out of English centers and do not support any attack on NOR.

France to Italy, Spring 1937: Understood. A MAR and A PAR stay off Piedmont and Tunis this spring, and F TUN stays clear of Marseille and Gascony. I will hold defensively. Please tell me if England's fleets move toward Portugal or the Channel west, and I will do the same for any Italian move toward Marseille or Spain.

A BEL and A BOH are mine; A RUH is also mine. I do not plan to move on Burgundy or Paris this spring. A BEL will hold, and my western forces will stay out of PAR, BRE, and BUR. I am not headed into Holland or Belgium with another unit.

I cannot guarantee A BOH stays out of VIE; it is positioned to pressure you, particularly if Turkey moves against you. I have no present plan to move against MUN or SIL. In the north, I am focused on the balance with England and will keep my forces out of English centers.

F SWE will hold, and F HEL will not support an attack on NOR. I will keep German forces out of English centers. Please keep F NTH and F DEN out of HEL, HOL, and KIE, and do not support an attack on Norway; then we can avoid broadening the dispute.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1937: Agreed. A VEN and A ROM stay out of TRI and SER this spring. My units are not moving against Venice or Trieste. A TYR is your unit, so please keep it out of Piedmont and Venice too. I will watch Turkey's movements toward Serbia and tell you if they threaten your southern line.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1937: My new army at Smyrna is staying east for now and will not head toward Greece or the Aegean coast near Naples. F ION and F GOL stay clear of Smyrna and Constantinople, and I expect the same from you. Let's keep the Mediterranean quiet while I deal with Austria in the north.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1937: I am not ordering anything into MOS, SEV, BUD, VIE or SER this spring, and A RUM stays put. Your A MOS and A ARM must stay out of SEV and RUM. If either moves on Turkish centers, I will respond, so keep your word and hold BUD, SER and GRE.

Turkey to Germany, Spring 1937: I will not move A RUM to SER or A UKR toward GAL this spring; that is too committal before I see your orders. Keep your forces out of Turkish centers and I will keep mine out of German ones. Show me your spring moves and we can talk about Austria in autumn.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1937: My A MOS and A SEV are in place, and A UKR is your unit near them. Please state plainly whether A UKR or F BLA moves into SEV or MOS this fall. I will not move A BUL or A MOS into RUM or your Bulgarian centers if you hold off my northern and eastern centers.

I’m holding F SWE and F DEN this fall and won’t move F HOL into your centers. Please keep F KIE and F BAL from contesting SWE or moving against my units; are you willing to leave the Scandinavian front quiet?
Can you move A BUR to RUH or PIC this fall to pressure Germany while I hold F SWE and F DEN? I’ll keep my forces out of French centers and ENG. Please keep A PAR and A MAR clear of my centers.
I’m focused on the German front and have no moves toward Austrian centers. Are you planning any northern moves toward STP or Scandinavia this fall? Please keep clear of my units in SWE and DEN.

France to Germany, Fall 1937: I have only three centers left after losing Brest-area strength, and your A BUR is adjacent to my A PAR. Confirm in writing that A BUR and A BEL stay out of PAR, MAR and BRE this fall. In return I will keep A PAR and A MAR defensive and will not move toward Belgium or Holland.

Austria still has 7 centers and is the main obstacle to either of us expanding. Will you commit A RUM to SER and A UKR to GAL this fall? I can use A SIL to pressure BOH or A LVN toward WAR. Keep your forces clear of German centers.

Your forces and mine are now close on several fronts. Are A VIE and A BUD staying out of German centers this fall? I will keep A BUR and A RUH out of Austrian territory if you confirm you will not move against MUN, SIL, or BER.

With F DEN and F HOL near German centers, I want to avoid a northern clash. Please keep your fleets out of KIE and BAL this fall; I will not move F BAL or F KIE against your centers. What are your plans for F DEN and F SWE?

Italy to France, Fall 1937: Our understanding holds on Marseille, Gascony and Spain. Note F SPA/SOUTH is mine, and I will keep it off Portugal and Gascony. Please tell me if England's fleets head toward Portugal or the Mid-Atlantic, and I will do the same for any French move toward Tunis or Piedmont.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1937: Your A MOS and A SEV are now a direct question. Tell me plainly whether A MOS or A BUL moves against SEV, RUM or Turkish Balkan centers this fall. I will not order into MOS, VIE, BUD or SER, but if you strike Bulgaria or Rumania, I will respond at once.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1937: I will not order A MOS, A SEV or A BUL into RUM or your Bulgarian or Rumanian centers this fall. Your A UKR and F BLA are the units that border my SEV and MOS. Confirm in writing that neither moves into SEV, MOS, BUD, VIE or SER and we keep the peace in the east.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1937: A VIE and A BUD will not move into MUN, SIL, BER or BUR this fall. I have no orders against German centers. Keep A BOH and A RUH out of VIE and TYR, and A BUR away from Austrian ground, and we stay aligned while I hold the Turkish front.
Austria to England: I have no orders toward STP, NOR, SWE or DEN this fall. My focus is Turkey and the Balkans. Keep your fleets out of Austrian territory and we have no quarrel.
